up: Retrieve all compounds that are referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5441456. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (the public identifier from the molecule dictionary), its preferred name (from the molecule dictionary), and its canonical SMILES (from the compound structures). Ensure each distinct compound is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5441456';
